name: Value read and never written
definition: A value, field or state is read, mapped or required by one component and no row, task or step writes it for that case.
question_template: This text reads or returns on the value «value». Does any row or task write that value? Quote it. PROBLEM if none does.
severity_guidance: Blocking when a reader keys on a value that nothing sets; minor when a stated default covers the case.
known_weakness: High false-positive rate and low trust; class support is weak, so it is plausible only.
